children.text: Show tutorial in the first level. Lock the players and camera zoom while the tutorial is on-screen.
In any other level, Immediately move the camera to show both players (position and zoom).
If the tutorial is up, pressing space will close it and begin the game.
Adjust camera to show both players.

children.functionDescription: Adjust camera to show both players.

functionParameters.name: adjustZoom
functionParameters.comment: Should the zoom be adjusted as well?

children.name: neededWidth
children.comment: Needed width for viewport to cover both players.

children.name: neededHeight
children.comment: Needed height for viewport to cover both players.

children.text: Scroll the camera to the average position between the players.

parameters.x: immediately ? (x0 + x1) / 2 : lerp(scrollx, (x0 + x1) / 2, SCROLL_SPEED * dt)
parameters.y: immediately ? (y0 + y1) / 2 : lerp(scrolly, (y0 + y1) / 2, SCROLL_SPEED * dt)

children.text: Zoom in and out as needed to always show both players.

parameters.scale: immediately ? clamp(min(384 / neededWidth, 216 / neededHeight), 0.1, 1) : lerp(LayerScale("Game"), clamp(min(384 / neededWidth, 216 / neededHeight), 0.1, 1), ZOOM_SPEED * dt)

children.text:
Control the camera position depending on the amount of players alive.
- If both players are alive, adjust the camera to show both of them.
- Otherwise, focus the last recorded death position.
The number of players alive change how the camera behaves.
Both players are alive, therefore adjust the camera to show both players.
Make the camera focus the last recorded death position.

children.text: If the player is on the floor, set their animation to Walk or Idle depending on their X movement vector.
Otherwise, if the player is midair, set their animation to Jump or Fall according to their Y movement vector.
Apply a simple tween effect when the player jumps or lands.
